## Standards

No hard violation of `CLAUDE.md` or `README.md` was established. Souls were unchanged, mechanical contracts remain in schema/runtime, and no permanent probe was introduced.

### Judgement-call smells

1. **Possible Divergent Change — `src/reviewer-agent.ts`**

   The module now owns several independently changing concerns:

   > `async function prepareSnapshot(...)`  
   > `async function prepareWorkspace(...)`  
   > `async function createChildRuntime(...)`  
   > `async function runChild(...)`  
   > `export function createReviewerAgentRunner(...)`

   Git snapshotting, temporary-workspace lifecycle, provider/auth inheritance, child-session execution, usage accounting, and dispatch coordination are distinct responsibilities. Consider separating workspace materialization, child runtime/session management, and orchestration.

2. **Possible Divergent Change — `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts`**

   > `export function parseReviewerCapabilities(...)`  
   > `async function preflightAndCompileDispatch(...)`  
   > `export function createReviewerDispatcher(...)`

   Capability-document decoding, proposal validation, Git-range/material policy, canonical-Skill prompt compilation, and concurrent acceptance lifecycle share one module. Extracting the capability codec and deterministic prompt compiler would reduce unrelated reasons for this file to change.

No reviewed-target or probe files were modified during review. The diff capture produced by the permitted command was scratch outside the clone.

## Spec

**[P2] The runner interface still exposes construction semantics.**

Spec: “**The runner cannot inspect/recompile proposal semantics: it receives only frozen accepted prompt bytes/grants and pinned identity.**”

`AcceptedReviewerDispatch` includes exact task and capability-document text, range data, and all resolved material bytes (`src/reviewer-dispatch.ts:63–79`). `src/reviewer-role.ts:120` forwards that entire object unchanged to `runDispatch`, and `src/reviewer-agent.ts:536` accepts it directly. Although the current runner does not read every field, the interface does not make inspection unrepresentable as required.

Project the complete accepted evidence directly to the ledger, but pass the runner a narrower opaque execution value containing only dispatch identity, pinned target, accepted operational prerequisites, and immutable legs/prompts/grants.

No additional scope creep or incorrect behavior was established. No probe changes or scratch artifacts were created.

**Summary:** Standards — 2 judgement-call findings; worst is the concentration of Git, provider, child-session, and orchestration responsibilities in `src/reviewer-agent.ts`. Spec — 1 finding; worst is the P2 runner-interface violation exposing construction semantics.
